title: Battle of Otlukbeli
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Otlukbeli", at revision 1382312774, opens: "The Battle of Otlukbeli The Battle of Otlukbeli was a pitched battle that took place on August 11, 1473, between the Ottoman army under the command of Sultan Mehmed the Conqueror and the army of the Aq Qoyunlu state led by Sultan Uzun Hasan, at the Otlukbeli location within the borders of present-day Erzincan. This military conflict, which pitted the two major Turkic-Islamic states in Anatolia against each other, resulted in a victory for the Ottoman Empire." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2007212, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1473 battle between the Aq Qoyunlu and the Ottoman Empire". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
